headline: As of 2026-10-15: 6,141,017 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 37 of 50 states, D+21.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 6,141,017 early/mail ballots cast so far across 37 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+21.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (768,785), Florida (735,099), Virginia (604,369).
